processing.local_dedupe.description: This is the local fallback executor for the processing service's semantic dedupe rule. The main path is owned by the processing service (a local background service); when a subscription is not covered by the processing service, the desktop app runs an on-device model for an immediate, approximate dedupe. It only works on the Electron desktop app, and turning it off stops the client from doing any local dedupe. Note: the local fallback now covers every subscription category, which increases model usage.
processing.local_dedupe.enabled.descript: When off, the client no longer performs any local semantic dedupe; entries the processing service does not cover lose their immediate fallback.
processing.local_dedupe.enabled.label: Enable local fallback executor

semantic.definition.event:business_expan: A company expands markets, regions, channels, customers or business scope; this alone does not imply a product launch.
semantic.definition.event:feature_update: A specific existing product changes its features, interfaces or behavior.
semantic.definition.event:fund_flow: Reported inflows, outflows or net flows with an identifiable object, period or measurement basis. Price changes, individual asset transfers and institutional purchases alone do not establish fund flow.
semantic.definition.event:funding: A company or project receives financing with an identifiable recipient and transaction.
semantic.definition.event:incentive_aird: Concrete reward, airdrop eligibility or claim arrangements; generic profit promises and referral ads do not qualify.
semantic.definition.event:institutional_: An institution purchases or increases digital-asset holdings with an identified institution and asset.
An institution invests in a company, project or business; digital-asset accumulation is assessed separately.
semantic.definition.event:listing_tradin: Confirmed listing, delisting, trading pair or suspension arrangements; brand mentions and rumors do not qualify.
semantic.definition.event:macro_change: Sourced interest rate, inflation, employment, monetary or fiscal changes; market sentiment does not qualify.
semantic.definition.event:product_launch: A specific product, service, tool or API is first released and available; company expansion or investment alone does not qualify.
semantic.definition.event:regulation: Legal, regulatory or enforcement changes with identifiable subjects and arrangements; speculation does not qualify.
semantic.definition.event:security_incid: An evidenced attack, exploit, theft, leak or security incident; marketing warnings and rumors do not qualify.
semantic.definition.event:tokenomics_cha: Concrete supply, unlock, burn, distribution or economic mechanism changes; price predictions do not qualify.
semantic.definition.form:pure_entertainm: Entertainment without substantive facts, experience, methods, or reasoning.
semantic.definition.form:review: Comparisons or evaluations with identifiable firsthand usage evidence.
semantic.definition.form:tutorial: Learnable methods or steps; unseen linked text is not assumed.
semantic.definition.signal:concrete_expe: Verifiable practical conditions, steps, results or failures; generic opinions do not qualify.
semantic.definition.signal:empty_opinion: General opinions or slogans without facts, specific experience, or reasoning.
semantic.definition.signal:original_data: Firsthand measurements or disclosures with identifiable sources or methods.
semantic.definition.signal:pure_promotio: Promotion with no usable information after removing its solicitation.
semantic.definition.signal:reasoned_anal: Analysis with evidence and an explicit reasoning process.
semantic.definition.signal:social_chatte: Greetings or status updates without new facts or usable methods.
semantic.definition.topic:ai: Substantive discussion of AI models, methods, applications, or impacts.
semantic.definition.topic:blockchain: Substantive discussion of blockchain protocols, onchain activities, or ecosystems.
semantic.definition.topic:blockchain_inf: Substantive discussion of blockchain nodes, validators, clients, scaling, development or underlying protocol infrastructure.
semantic.definition.topic:defi: Substantive discussion of decentralized onchain finance such as lending, trading or yield.
semantic.definition.topic:fintech: Substantive discussion of digital payments, banking, lending or financial-service technology and business; a fintech company name alone does not imply a product.
semantic.definition.topic:music: Substantive discussion of composition, performance, theory, instruments, or the music industry.
semantic.definition.topic:personal_growt: Learning, skills or habit development with usable methods, experience or evidence; motivational slogans do not qualify.
semantic.definition.topic:product: Substantive discussion of an identifiable product, service, tool or API with concrete features, interfaces or usage; financing, investment, holdings, fund flows or expansion alone do not qualify.
